title: Police Knew He Was Hiding Something
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 23rd, 2022.  Officers conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle that failed to signal before turning. When the officers asked the driver (Charles) for his license, he failed to provide it. The officers also noticed the man had weed residue all over him which prompted him to step out of the vehicle. Upon further investigation, officers found out that the man had multiple active warrants (one for speeding and another for no drivers licence) and had 5 previous convictions for no Drivers License, when the officers placed him under arrest, he started freaking out and resisting arrest prompting officers to pepper spray him, he then started frantically reaching for things in his pocket The passenger in the vehicle was also acting in a suspicious manner & officers also noticed weed residue on his shirt. Upon further investigation, the officers found that Tim was a sex offender out of Louisiana & they also located (Anadrol-50 (oxymetholone)) on the passenger side of the vehicle which is a steroid. When the officers questioned him about it, the man tried to lie and say it was some sort of vitamin he uses, and could not provide a clear explanation on where he got it from. This is the body-cam footage of the events that happened.
